Hi! 👋

My name is Tony and I write this blog. I am currently a postdoctoral researcher in Taiwan. Why Taiwan? Well, a
series of life choices fresh from university led me here. I did not start the program until late. I am, what you would
call, a late bloomer. And still learning!

I will treat this as a place to practice code and share my thinking and thought processes.

You can find the repository for this site [here](https://github.com/tlint101/practice-in-code).

Any posts with code on this site will be packaged in a Jupyter or Marimo Notebook and can be found [here](https://github.com/tlint101/practice-in-code/tree/main/notebooks)

Thanks for visiting!
:::
